name: CPWAdminData
title: CPWAdminData
description: This is an ArcGIS Feature Service generated by the Colorado Parks and Wildlife GIS Unit on August 27, 2026 for distributing Colorado state parks and wildlife GIS data for public distribution.
snippet: CPW Administrative Boundary AGOL hosted web service data to provide public access to CPW data including CPW Facilities, Roads, Trails, Gold Medal Waters, Property Ownership, Game Management Units, Walk In Access Program, and Organizational Boundaries
